Step Action: Log in to D2R2 as an SSO user using the current Windows session
Step Expected: The D2R2 Home page is displayed

Step Action: Open the D2R2 Home page
Step Expected: The Home page is displayed with the D2R2 menu

Step Action: Request GET /Session/Status while signed in
Step Expected: The request returns HTTP 200 with JSON
